falsification.f2: identity, handedness-flipped and every Haar-random side-link variant above 1 + t
falsification.g3: each side window's linked reading on its predicted side of zero; part of the primary claim
falsification.g5_secondary: every link's parity agrees with the oracle's
falsification.haar_rng: default_rng([2026113050, replicate]), 64 draws of the four side windows in the order of their offsets

interruptions: a MemoryError anywhere, a worker's non-zero exit, or a failed counterfactual map or replay stops the run without a summary; never a replicate failure
scope: Accuracy gate on the amplitude along the true tensor for one plane wave, amplitude and interval size, with the single window as control and falsification gates for the side windows and links; no full-tensor, per-link handedness, fine link-accuracy, generality or single-replicate claim
